summary: Remote-controlled shell and file/process access driven by hardcoded AppSync endpoint
details: The CLI connects to a hardcoded AppSync GraphQL WebSocket at https://api.ai-support-agent.com and subscribes to command messages of the form action: 'agent-command'. Incoming messages are dispatched to local handlers that provide the capabilities 'shell', 'file_read', 'file_write', 'process_manage', 'terminal', and 'vscode', including PTY/terminal execution on the installer's host. In addition, dist/cli/service/darwin-service.js and dist/cli/service/linux-service.js install the CLI as a persistent user/system service with PATH modifications so the agent runs continuously. The apiUrl is a compile-time default and no cryptographic authentication of server-issued commands is visible in the traced code paths, so whoever controls the AppSync backend can execute arbitrary commands on any host running the agent. Network destinations reachable from the client include api.ai-support-agent.com (AppSync) and, in the VS Code server component, a local http.get bridge on 127.0.0.1.
